text:
mira: FYI bringing up compact-aurelia-v2-int8 on staging. Quick smoke show: weird merges for Hangul Jamo sequences and some RTL punctuation collapse when Arabic and CJK mix. Anyone seen this pattern with recent quant kernels? :eyes:

devon: can you paste a minimal repro and the eval command you ran? also which quant profile (symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel)?

mira: repro snippets below + command I used:
```
# sample inputs (UTF-8)
1) Hangul jamo sequence: 하늘
2) Mixed CJK+Arabic: مرحبا，世界
3) ZWNJ/ZWJ corner: katakana?? (weird glue)

# eval run
./run_eval --model compact-aurelia-v2-int8 --split staging-smoke --tokenizer-check --batch 16 --quant-profile per_channel_sym_q8
```

devon: thanks. quick thought: tokenization differences often come from tokenizer merges or a regenerated BPE table. but if it's only on int8 maybe kernel rounding is exposing a downstream detok bug. can you dump token ids for the first sample?

mira: dumped tokens for sample 1: `['ᄒ', 'ᅡ', 'ᄂ', 'ᅳ', 'ᆯ'] -> ids [24931, 18012, 24945, 18025, 34012]` on fp16 build, but on int8 candidate it was `['가', 'ᄂ', 'ᅳ', 'ᆯ'] -> ids [1342, 24945, 18025, 34012]` — so the jamo pair merged into single precomposed syllable incorrectly.

eval-bot: automated eval summary (staging-smoke):
- ja/ko translation BLEU delta: -2.9 (vs aurelia-v2-fp16)
- tokenization mismatch rate: 0.42 -> 0.73
- embedding L2 drift: +0.066
Link: https://ci.internal/reports/2923456789 (staging)

jing: that merge looks like a tokenizer detok postprocess rule firing when byte-level meld happens. but why only int8? two guesses: 1) quantized tokenizer weights (if we have learned BPE merges) were baked differently, or 2) the runtime's detokenizer fallback after kernel rounding is doing a normalization pass. run `scripts/tokenizer_inspect.py --input "하늘" --model compact-aurelia-v2-int8` and paste the tokenization graph.

mira: output from tokenizer_inspect (trimmed):
``
[graph] ᄒ + ᅡ -> 0x534 (merge rule triggered)
rule_source: post_detok_normalize.py:line 72 (detected by runtime)
fallback_path: kernel_qk-2.3.1/fuse_detok
```

alon: we saw a similar post_detok_normalize rule with compact-xpress rollout earlier but that was triggered by a Unicode normalization flag flip in the runtime. cc @infra-bot for recent kernel/flag rollouts.

infra-bot: kernel rollout log: qk-2.3.1 deployed to staging GPUs 2026-02-18T03:22:41Z. change: enable fused_detok_normalize by default for q8 kernels. Rollback possible to qk-2.2.9.

satoshi: probable repro path: quant kernel fused_detok does a cheap NFC/NFKC normalization under certain token-boundary heuristics, and the integerized comparator used for merge detection was using truncated float thresholds -> accidental merges for combining jamo. can you run the same eval with `--kernel qk-2.2.9 --disable-fused-detok`? that should isolate kernel behavior vs tokenizer artifact.

devon: propose a short bisect plan:
- run smoke with qk-2.2.9 + disable fused_detok (baseline)
- run qk-2.3.1 + disable fused_detok (checks kernel changes unrelated to fused_detok)
- run qk-2.3.1 with fused_detok enabled (replicate current)
collect token-level diffs and BLEU for the 50-sample smoke set. if dups only when fused_detok enabled -> kernel flag is culprit.

jing: I'll take the first two runs locally and push the token-diff artifacts to the bringup CI. mira can you add the 3rd run to staging and share links?

mira: started run with qk-2.2.9 + --disable-fused-detok. ETA ~12m. dataset: locale-smoke/ko-ja-50.

eval-bot: run queued: build-compact-int8-bisect-2923456795. expecting output in ~15m.

mira: quick note — observed one more oddity: Arabic punctuation `،` next to CJK comma `，` sometimes collapsed into ASCII comma when mixed RTL/LTR present on int8 run. might be related to same fused normalization.

devon: good catch. if this repros we should add a targeted unit test to tokenizer ci: a handful of mixed RTL+CJK pairs and Jamo combining sequences. failing test should block int8 bringup until we have a mitigation (disable fused_detok or refine heuristics).

satoshi: agreed. mitigation options: revert to qk-2.2.9 for GA, or patch fused_detok to run stricter Unicode category checks before merging. patch will be small but needs kernel rollout.

jing: running local reproducer now, will post token diff artifacts and a proposed unit test patch in ~30m.

mira: thanks everyone. planning a short sync in 30 to decide rollback vs patch. :thumbsup:

devon: ack. ping me if you need help with CI artifacts.

infra-bot: note: rollback window open for qk-2.3.1 until 2026-02-19T06:00:00Z.

mira: pairing invite sent to devon/jing/satoshi for 30m.

jing: quick status: reproducer confirms merged jamo on qk-2.3.1 with fused_detok enabled, no merge on qk-2.2.9. attaching diffs to the bringup artifact at https://ci.internal/artifacts/2923456789/diff.tar.gz

mira: received, thanks. we'll decide after the sync. :eyes:"
